scope: Implementation of isolated STATUS observer wrappers; reused native ABI/startup evidence. No installer or live game call.

claims.Finding: Initialize receives STATUS in RCX and returns the original RAX. Startup also invokes it for slots that are not allocated.
claims.Limitations: Reused full-body static evidence for this exact retail build. Wrapper tests use synthetic callbacks; no installation safety, runtime availability or whole-program writer closure is claimed.

claims.Finding: Rebuild receives STATUS in RCX and an optional character-save pointer in RDX; the wrapper preserves the returned RAX.
claims.Limitations: Reused full-body static evidence for this exact retail build. Wrapper tests use synthetic callbacks; no installation safety, runtime availability or whole-program writer closure is claimed.

claims.Finding: Coefficient receives STATUS in RCX, signed index in EDX and signed percentage in R8D; the wrapper preserves the returned RAX and does not sanitize native arguments.
claims.Limitations: Reused full-body static evidence for this exact retail build. Wrapper tests use synthetic callbacks; no installation safety, runtime availability or whole-program writer closure is claimed.

claims.Finding: Reset receives the pool in RCX and replaces the 80-entry free list/count independently of old STATUS field bytes.
claims.Limitations: Reused full-body static evidence for this exact retail build. Wrapper tests use synthetic callbacks; no installation safety, runtime availability or whole-program writer closure is claimed.

claims.Finding: Release decrements STATUS+612 after saveback and frees the slot when the result is nonpositive; the observer validates and uses the pre-call positive refcount.
claims.Limitations: Reused full-body static evidence for this exact retail build. Wrapper tests use synthetic callbacks; no installation safety, runtime availability or whole-program writer closure is claimed.

claims.Finding: Startup initializes all 80 STATUS slots before constructing their free list. Init observation therefore cannot require a preexisting allocated slot.
claims.Limitations: Reused full-body static evidence for this exact retail build. Wrapper tests use synthetic callbacks; no installation safety, runtime availability or whole-program writer closure is claimed.

notes: Before/After assume a valid retained Observer and valid bound originals. Own pool-read and transaction SEH is bounded and separate from propagating native SEH.
ArmAfterProvenBarrier is an installer precondition. It does not establish that external barrier itself.
WithMetadata allows a complete typed compare/receipt/write operation under one lock. Caller must validate Actor lifetime, context and exact field bits.
